name: @local/dsh-workspace-session
description: Workspace-scoped session sync for DeepSeek Harness: mirrors workspace sessions into <workspace>/.dsh/sessions as git-friendly JSONL snapshots, imports them back on other machines, and keeps native ~/.dsh/sessions as the runtime store.

scripts.check: for f in index.js client.js lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
